tasks.name: Selective anticancer activity
tasks.goal: Generate peptides with promising anticancer activity while maintaining low toxicity toward healthy cells.
tasks.description: Adapt a peptide generator toward anticancer activity while considering toxicity to healthy cells.
tasks.proxy: DPO, DiffusionNFT and Guidance optimize the frozen ACP-A anticancer predictor. AntiCP2-alt. and HemoPI2 are downstream evaluation metrics.
tasks.observableSummary: Sequence, composition and relative developability bands; target-specific activity and the HemoPI2 evaluator are not shown to the teacher.

tasks.name: Cell penetration
tasks.goal: Generate peptides with promising mammalian-cell-penetrating activity while minimizing toxicity to mammalian cells.
tasks.description: Adapt a peptide generator toward mammalian-cell penetration while considering toxicity.
tasks.proxy: DPO, DiffusionNFT and Guidance optimize a CellPPD-trained classifier. pLM4CPPs and HemoPI2 are downstream evaluators; the CPP reward and evaluator share historical labels.
tasks.observableSummary: Sequence, composition and relative developability bands; the teacher does not see the CPP reward or downstream evaluator scores.

tasks.name: Dopamine D2 receptor
tasks.goal: Generate promising drug-like small molecules for binding the dopamine D2 receptor, balancing plausible receptor recognition with moderate lipophilicity and chemically viable structures.
tasks.description: Generate plausible drug-like candidates for dopamine D2 receptor binding, with moderate lipophilicity.
tasks.proxy: DPO, Flow-GRPO, DiffusionNFT and Guidance optimize a TDC-DRD2 reward with a MolLogP term. GNINA, Vina and rDock provide the reported docking evaluations.
tasks.observableSummary: Molecular structure, physicochemical descriptors and geometry checks, including Crippen LogP; docking scores are not shown to the teacher.

tasks.name: GSK3β binding
tasks.goal: Generate promising drug-like small molecules for binding the ATP pocket of glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (GSK3β), while maintaining reasonable aqueous solubility and chemically plausible structures.
tasks.description: Generate plausible candidates for the GSK3β ATP pocket, with reasonable aqueous solubility.
tasks.proxy: DPO, Flow-GRPO, DiffusionNFT and Guidance optimize a TDC GSK3β activity classifier. GNINA, Vina and rDock provide the reported docking evaluations.
tasks.observableSummary: Molecular structure, physicochemical descriptors and geometry checks. Numerical LogP, activity/solubility predictions, and docking scores or poses are not shown to the teacher.
observables: Graph-local functional groups with atom indices

tasks.name: Constrained molecular design
tasks.goal: Generate neutral, connected small molecules for a kinase-focused discovery campaign that contain a six-membered aza-aromatic ring bearing a free primary amino group on a ring carbon adjacent to a pyridine-like ring nitrogen, and a distinct fully saturated ring containing a free secondary amine.
tasks.description: Reach a rare molecular region defined by a conjunction of structural constraints stated in natural language.
tasks.proxy: Reward-guided baselines receive an LLM-generated binary checker for the full structural goal. The paper reports that these baselines fail to find a hit.
tasks.observableSummary: Molecular structure, physicochemical descriptors, atom-indexed functional groups and geometry checks; evidence availability is reported explicitly.
observables: Graph-local functional groups with atom indices

source: Goals 1–5 of the supplied preprint; exact wording verified against pages 6, 8, and 9.

dockingDisplay.negativeScores: Vina and rDock are converted to absolute values before subtracting the pretrained magnitude. The resulting delta retains its sign; original signed scores remain in the table and hover details.
dockingDisplay.label: Reported uncertainty
dockingDisplay.caption: Error bars retain each method’s printed ± term, with the pretrained mean treated as a fixed reference.
dockingDisplay.sourceNote: Table 2 does not specify the uncertainty type. Original method error terms are translated by subtracting the reported pretrained magnitude, treated as fixed; these are not intervals jointly estimating uncertainty in both means. No confidence level or covariance is inferred.
